🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Sanjay Gupta, the Bollywood filmmaker behind the crime dramas Kaante, Shootout at Lokhandwala and Kaabil, has died after a fall at his home in Mumbai, India.

Gupta died on Friday, October 30, 2026, at his home in the Versova area of Mumbai, according to Mumbai Police. Police said he lost his balance and fell inside his home, sustaining a head injury that led to bleeding. His body was sent for a post-mortem examination, and Versova police registered an accidental death report, with an inquiry underway.

His death was confirmed on Saturday, October 31, by filmmaker Milap Zaveri, a close friend, who told the Press Trust of India that Gupta had fallen and hit his head. Filmmaker Ashoke Pandit also confirmed the news.

Gupta built his name on stylish Hindi crime and action films, directing Kaante (2002), Musafir, Zinda, Shootout at Lokhandwala and Kaabil (2017), and producing several more. Reports differed on his age, listing him as 57 or 59.

He is survived by his wife, Anuradha, and their two children.

Rest in Peace.

Sources: Variety; Deadline; Press Trust of India; Mumbai Police, via PTI and ANI reports.

title: Beyond the 956: Sanjay Gupta, 'Kaante' and 'Kaabil' filmmaker, dies after fall at Mumbai home
